blocks.title: Acronis Cyber Protection Solutions
blocks.subtitle: Backup. Security. Recovery. All in One.
paragraphs: Protect your business data and systems with Acronis Cyber Protect — the industry-leading platform that combines backup, anti-ransomware, endpoint security, and disaster recovery into a single, unified solution. As an Acronis partner, True Line delivers, deploys, and manages Acronis for businesses across the UAE.

blocks.title: One Platform. Complete Cyber Protection.
paragraphs: Backup alone isn't enough anymore. Modern threats target both your data and your backups — meaning traditional backup tools often fail exactly when you need them most. That's why Acronis combines backup, cybersecurity, and disaster recovery in a single, integrated platform.

As a trusted Acronis partner, True Line helps businesses deploy and manage Acronis Cyber Protect to safeguard everything — laptops, servers, virtual machines, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and more. From ransomware protection to instant recovery, we make sure your data, systems, and business are always protected and always recoverable.
